name: Formatted code
summary: A code shown for reading, such as 123 456: grouped, monospace, left to right in every language, and read digit by digit by screen readers.

when: To show a sign-in code, such as in the recovery email.

anatomy.description: The digits, in groups of three.

props.name: code
props.description: The code, with or without spaces.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Read digit by digit, such as “1 2 3 4 5 6”, not as a number.
notes: Never translated, and always left to right.

guidelines: Codes are never translated, and always use the digits people type.

evidence.point: Grouped digits are easier to read and copy correctly; screen readers otherwise read them as one large number.
